name: Theme Toggle
description: View Transitions API powered theme toggle button with tactile obsidian candy styling, geometric clip-path ripples, and seamless mode synchronization.
summary: A high-performance theme toggle switch engineered for seamless transitions between dark and light modes. Powered by the native View Transitions API with custom SVG polygon and circular clipping paths, delivering 60fps geometric morphs across the viewport. Features an ultra-tactile obsidian candy button with physical specular reflections, upper glass dome sheen, and hardware-accelerated press compression.
highlights: Hardware-accelerated native View Transitions API with polygon and circular clipping path morphing
Seven geometric ripple shape transitions: circle, square, triangle, diamond, hexagon, rectangle, and star
Tactile obsidian candy gemstone button style with physical radial shaders, specular reflection rim, and glass sheen
Automatic dark and light mode detection with zero hydration flash via MutationObserver and system preference sync
Graceful degradation when the View Transitions API is unsupported or reduced motion is active
anatomy: <button> (Focus-visible interactive trigger shell with obsidian candy gradient or minimalist border)
<span> (Specular reflection line anchored along the upper perimeter)
<span> (Translucent glass dome sheen layer providing convex highlight)
<span> (Animated Lucide Sun and Moon icons with rotation micro-interactions)

physics.engine: View Transitions API & CSS Radial Shaders
physics.description: Screen-wide geometric clip-path expansion combined with tactile spring active compression and specular lighting insets.

parameters.label: Clip Geometry
parameters.value: circle / polygon coordinates dynamically computed from click origin

parameters.label: Tactile Compression
parameters.value: scale-[0.98] on active press with 150ms ease-out

accessibility.aria: Includes aria-label='Toggle theme' with accessible screen-reader state announcement.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Suppresses screen-wide clip path ripple when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

keyboard.description: Focuses the theme toggler with high-contrast dual ring.
Triggers theme transition with ripple morph.

recommended: Navigation bars, studio headers, and command palettes where smooth theme switching is desired
Interactive component libraries showcasing dark and light design tokens
Creative landing pages and portfolios featuring expressive micro-interactions
bestPractices: Use candy mode for tactile obsidian hero action matching GitHub candy button
Trigger from the click coordinate for natural ripple expansion across the viewport

props.name: variant
props.description: Geometric shape of the View Transition clip-path ripple across the viewport.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the view transition animation in milliseconds.

props.name: fromCenter
props.description: When true, ripple emanates from the center of the viewport instead of the button click position.

props.name: candy
props.description: Renders the tactile obsidian candy button style with specular reflections and glass sheen.

props.name: theme
props.description: Optional controlled theme state. When omitted, automatically synchronizes with document.documentElement.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Callback fired whenever the theme changes.
